# Sangkwaehan ENT Clinic (상쾌한이비인후과의원)

> English-speaking ENT (ear, nose & throat) specialist clinic in Jinhae, Changwon, South Korea.
> English information page: https://en.skhentml.com/
> Korean website: https://www.skhentml.com/

## Key facts

- Location: Suite 202 (2F), Hi-Zone Building, 999 Jinhae-daero, Jinhae-gu, Changwon-si, Gyeongsangnam-do, South Korea (Jaeun-dong)
- Phone: +82-55-547-3550
- Hours: Mon-Fri 9:00-18:30 (lunch 12:30-13:45), Sat 9:00-13:00 (no lunch break), closed Sun & Korean public holidays
- No appointment needed; walk-ins welcome
- International patients welcome; Korean NHIS accepted, self-pay available, documents issued for overseas insurance claims

## Areas served

- Jinhae-gu and Changwon city, Masan, Yongwon, and Jangyu and Yulha (Gimhae)

## Doctors

- Dr. Oh Jung-ho: Director, otolaryngology (ENT) specialist; consults in English; visiting professor, Kosin University College of Medicine
- Dr. Lee Young-jin: Director, board-certified pediatrician with pediatric emergency subspecialty

## Specialties

- Dizziness & vertigo: BPPV (canalith repositioning), Meniere's disease, vestibular neuritis; VNG and vHIT testing
- Hearing loss & tinnitus: audiometry, ABR, DPOAE (Interacoustics Eclipse); intratympanic steroid injection
- Hearing aids: prescription, fitting, aftercare; hearing-disability certification; Korean NHIS hearing-aid subsidy guidance
- Rhinitis & allergy: MAST (108 allergens), ImmunoCAP, skin prick test; sublingual immunotherapy (LAIS)
- Imaging: head & neck cone beam CT (Genoray Papaya, new in 2026), X-CUBE 90 ultrasound, Full HD ENT endoscopy
- Also: vaccinations, IV nutrition therapy (12 private rooms), ENT outpatient procedures, snoring/sleep evaluation, skin & aesthetic procedures
